summary.text: Jake Oliveira is a Democratic state senator representing the Hampden, Hampshire, and Worcester District, in office since January 2023, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election. Ballotpedia lists him as Jacob Oliveira.
He previously served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 2021 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Jacob Oliveira was born in Holyoke, Massachusetts, and lives in Ludlow, Massachusetts.
He graduated from Ludlow High School in 2004 and earned a bachelor's degree in government from Framingham State University in 2008.

His career experience includes working as an assistant executive officer with the Massachusetts State Universities Council of Presidents, as a middle-school teacher, and as a legislative aide in the Massachusetts House of Representatives.
Oliveira represented the 7th Hampden District in the Massachusetts House from 2021 to 2023, succeeding Thomas Petrolati, and assumed office in the State Senate on January 4, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session he chaired the Joint Committee on Labor and Workforce Development and was vice chair of the Joint Committee on Election Laws.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
